question: Does bounded confidence-weighted frozen-teacher auxiliary supervision change a solo public-input DINOv3 student relative to the identical ordinary student?
auxiliary: combined = label_loss + w * effective_batch_loss(student_logits, teacher_probabilities, confidence, confidence_counts); confidence = clamp(|2p-1| - across-window spread, 0, 1); fitting studies only; absent studies weight 0
zero_weight_contract: w=0 returns the label loss object itself and never evaluates the teacher term
evaluation: Existing 1156-study outer evaluation with accepted labels only; teacher never scores, selects or filters evaluation studies; no teacher at student inference
primary_endpoint: paired macro AUC difference with the repository's existing paired bootstrap; per-target results reported, including negative and undefined
secondary_descriptive: fitting-only teacher-vs-accepted-label agreement/disagreement/uncertain counts from teacher_evidence.disagreement; never used as ground truth
preconditions_before_any_fit: trainer integration reviewed in a separate change
release: private only; no submission of any diagnostic model
